in_marathi.name: Muktipriya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Muktipriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Muktipriya is a name of a goddess, often revered in Hindu tradition. She is the embodiment of liberation from suffering and bondage, and a symbol of spiritual freedom. Her name signifies the one who is dear to those who seek liberation.
